captions.detailed: A 3D-printable challenge coin with a simple cylindrical design. The top face features a thin, raised circular rim around its outer edge, forming a shallow recessed area in the center. The bottom face is completely flat, lacking any rim or engravings in this configuration.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric challenge coin in OpenSCAD with customizable diameter, thickness, and text on both the front and back. The user should be able to adjust parameters such as the text content, font height, character spacing, relief height, and rim width, allowing the front text to be raised and the reverse text to be recessed.
captions.factory: The script defines a 'coin' module that uses a union to combine a base cylinder with a raised 'face' module on the top, and a difference operation to subtract a mirrored 'face' module from the bottom to create engraved text. The 'face' module optionally generates a raised outer ring using a helper 'ring' module (which differences two cylinders) and wraps text along the top and bottom curves using an 'arc_text' module. The 'arc_text' module loops through individual characters, rotating and translating each character along a calculated radius using the external 'write' library.
